title: Analytical Query Design and Performance knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Analytical Query Design and Performance”?
options: It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.

Analytical queries define a row grain, compute metrics at that grain, and make ordering and tie behavior explicit. Aggregate queries collapse rows into groups; window functions calculate across related rows without collapsing the current row set.
questions.answer_key: Analytical queries define a row grain, compute metrics at that grain, and make ordering and tie behavior explicit. Aggregate queries collapse rows into groups; window functions calculate across related rows without collapsing the current row set.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains: Analytical queries define a row grain, compute metrics at that grain, and make ordering and tie behavior explicit. Aggregate queries collapse rows into groups; window functions calculate across related rows without collapsing the current row set.

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Analytical Query Design and Performance” safely?
options: Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements.
Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
questions.answer_key: Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements.
questions.explanation: Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.

questions.prompt: Before relying on an example for “Analytical Query Design and Performance”, what should be verified?
options: Assume a successful connection means the query and data model are correct.
Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
Run a broad production change before checking the current state.
Ignore version notes and infer behavior from an unrelated database engine.
questions.answer_key: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
questions.explanation: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
